submitted.rationale: I targeted the (Fe,Cr)VO4-type region, where (Fe+Cr) roughly equals V, because FeVO4's band gap is close to the 2.06 eV illumination. Of the three points measured, index 102 (Cr 0.17, Fe 0.37, V 0.46) gave the highest EQE, 0.082%. Adding more Cr (index 128) or cutting Cr while adding Fe (index 90) both lowered EQE, so the best value in this region seems to be near a moderate Cr level of about 0.17.

rejected.reason: Less Cr, more Fe: EQE 0.061%, lower than 102
